country_specific_notes.note: Nigeria is on the 2026-27 eligible country list. You must be a national and resident of an eligible country. The Hungarian Embassy in Abuja publicises the call.

required_documents.detail: Word form from the FAO call page; submit a complete, clearly named dossier by email

preparation_alerts: Incomplete dossiers are not considered; check the course description for the full document list
Courses only run if enough students enrol

selection_criteria.pass_rule: Final selection is made by the Hungarian universities

verification_status.verification_notes: FAO call page confirms Nigeria eligible, three English-taught master's programmes for 2026-27, coverage and the 21 Jan to 28 Feb 2026 email window. Applications go to an @fao.org address (shown in search results as REU-Scholarship@fao.org), not a personal email. Subsistence amount not stated. The 2024 tweet listed different programmes (environmental, crop production, horticulture); the offered courses change each year. Next call not announced.
